# Zeneesha

> Zeneesha is a specialist Workday consultancy based in the UK. We partner with mid-to-large organisations — across financial services, professional services, manufacturing, education, and the public sector — to implement, optimise, and manage their Workday HCM and Finance platform. Our focus is post go-live and beyond: ensuring Workday works the way your business actually works, not just on launch day.

## Core Services

- [Workday Implementation](https://erisagent.com/zeneesha/implementation/): End-to-end Workday HCM and Finance implementation. Covers requirements discovery, process mapping, configuration, data migration, integrations (Workday Studio, EIB), testing, change management, and hypercare.
- [AMS & Managed Support](https://erisagent.com/zeneesha/ams-support/): Ongoing Application Managed Services retainer. Incident resolution, change request management, bi-annual Workday release management, integration monitoring, and reporting maintenance.
- [Maximise](https://erisagent.com/zeneesha/maximise/): Workday optimisation and ROI realisation for existing customers. Business process redesign, reporting and analytics (Prism, BIRT, Composite), automation of manual processes, configuration review, adoption improvement.

## Topic Guides

- [Workday HCM in the UK](https://erisagent.com/zeneesha/workday-hcm-uk/): Complete guide to Workday HCM deployment for UK organisations — modules, compliance, NHS and public sector specifics.
- [What is Workday AMS Support?](https://erisagent.com/zeneesha/workday-ams/): Explanation of Workday Application Managed Services — what's included, SLAs, and when to use a partner vs in-house.
- [Workday Data Migration](https://erisagent.com/zeneesha/workday-data-migration/): End-to-end guide to Workday data migration — source extraction, cleansing, EIB loading, validation, and cutover.
- [Workday for Mid-Market](https://erisagent.com/zeneesha/workday-mid-market/): How mid-market businesses (250–2,500 employees) select, implement, and get value from Workday.
- [Workday Finance & Payroll Training](https://erisagent.com/zeneesha/workday-finance-training/): Training resources and best practices for Workday Financials and Payroll end users and administrators.
- [Workday AI & Machine Learning](https://erisagent.com/zeneesha/workday-ai/): Overview of Workday's native AI and ML capabilities — skills cloud, VNDLY, Workday Illuminate, and predictive analytics.
